title: Levels for missing creatures
changes: Add levels and experience mappings for 60 previously uncovered creatures while preserving existing mod creature mappings.
Meadows skeletons display level 8, and wild Black Forest roots display level 15. Later-biome and sleeping variants follow the existing progression.
Summoned companions and offspring grant no kill XP. Require Shared 1.0.26 with Compatibility 1.0.17.
